problem_title: Recurring Tarring Or Asphalting Of Existing Road — Girinagar (2019–2020)
problem_summary: 5 citizen complaints about 'Tarring Or Asphalting Of Existing Road' were recorded in Girinagar between October 2019 and January 2020, spanning 2 calendar year(s). 40% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened).
representative_subcategory: Tarring Or Asphalting Of Existing Road

evidence_items.source: I Change My City (ichangemycity.com) via OpenCity

evidence_items.description: KAUN 2022 data: ward recorded 81 pothole complaints.
23 road/drain work order(s) sanctioned in ward (₹16.0 crore, FY 2023-24, 2024-25). Note: work order ward mapping uses datameet243 numbering (fuzzy_name join).

agency_attribution_note: 5 of 5 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
priority_rationale: Priority tier LOW (score=0.31). Top scoring factors: recurrence_years=0.67, unresolved_rate=0.40, complaint_volume=0.17.
ward_join_note: ICMC ward_name='Girinagar' matched to datameet243=213 via fuzzy_name (overlap_confidence=0.628).
recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for Girinagar for the period 2019–2020.
Request inspection records for the 23 work order(s) sanctioned in this ward to verify whether road works covered the affected stretch.
Re-survey affected stretch using a civic volunteer or journalist to document current road condition.
